**Finding submitted: deviation on § 14.2 (p0054).**

- **Issue:** Vendor takes exclusive ownership of every Deliverable created for Customer, leaving us only a revocable, non-transferable, term-limited licence — below both the preferred (we own what we pay for, Vendor assigns) and the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence with modify/sublicense rights).
- **Already at preferred elsewhere:** Customer Data ownership and the narrow Vendor processing right (§ 14.1), Vendor's retention of Vendor Technology (§ 14.3 with § 1.8), the perpetual/irrevocable/royalty-free licence to embedded Vendor Technology (§ 13.2), and no joint ownership absent a signed instrument (§ 14.4).
- **Cure (one surgical replace):** § 14.2 now reads that Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable and Vendor assigns all right, title and interest in it — leaving §§ 13.2, 14.3 and 10.1 intact with no dangling references.
